from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==========================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION
# ==========================================

# Sec 10(13A) / Rule 2A: HRA exemption percentages
HRA_METRO_PCT = Decimal('0.50')              # Sec 10(13A)(c): Metro 50%
HRA_NON_METRO_PCT = Decimal('0.40')          # Sec 10(13A)(c): Non-metro 40%
HRA_RENT_EXCESS_PCT = Decimal('0.10')        # Sec 10(13A)(b): 10% of salary

# Sec 16(ia): Standard deduction
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal('50000')         # Sec 16(ia) old regime limit
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal('75000')         # Sec 16(ia) / Sec 115BAC new regime limit

# Sec 24(b) & Sec 71(3A): Self-occupied house property interest deduction and setoff limit
SOP_INTEREST_LIMIT = Decimal('200000')       # Sec 24(b) & 71(3A) limit

# Sec 80C & Sec 80CCE: Chapter VI-A investment limit
SEC_80C_LIMIT = Decimal('150000')            # Sec 80CCE aggregate limit for 80C

# Sec 80CCD(1B): Additional NPS contribution limit
SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT = Decimal('50000')        # Sec 80CCD(1B) limit

# Sec 80D: Health insurance limits
SEC_80D_SELF_NON_SENIOR = Decimal('25000')   # Sec 80D(1)(i) non-senior
SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal('50000')       # Sec 80D(1)(i) senior
SEC_80D_PARENTS_NON_SENIOR = Decimal('25000')# Sec 80D(1)(ii) non-senior
SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal('50000')    # Sec 80D(1)(ii) senior

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A: Old regime tax brackets and rates
# (I) Below 60 years
SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60 = [
    (Decimal('250000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]
SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60_BASIC = Decimal('250000')

# (II) Senior citizen (60 to <80)
SLABS_OLD_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('300000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]
SLABS_OLD_SENIOR_BASIC = Decimal('300000')

# (III) Super senior citizen (80+)
SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]
SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR_BASIC = Decimal('500000')

# Sec 115BAC: New tax regime tax brackets and rates
SLABS_NEW = [
    (Decimal('300000'), Decimal('700000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('700000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.10')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('1200000'), Decimal('0.15')),
    (Decimal('1200000'), Decimal('1500000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1500000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]
SLABS_NEW_BASIC = Decimal('300000')

# Sec 87A: Rebate limits and thresholds
REBATE_OLD_LIMIT = Decimal('500000')
REBATE_OLD_MAX = Decimal('12500')
REBATE_NEW_LIMIT = Decimal('700000')
REBATE_NEW_MAX = Decimal('25000')

# Surcharge thresholds and rates
# Old regime: 50L, 1Cr, 2Cr, 5Cr -> 10%, 15%, 25%, 37%
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_OLD = [
    (Decimal('5000000'), Decimal('0.10')),
    (Decimal('10000000'), Decimal('0.15')),
    (Decimal('20000000'), Decimal('0.25')),
    (Decimal('50000000'), Decimal('0.37')),
]

# New regime (Sec 115BAC): 50L, 1Cr, 2Cr -> 10%, 15%, 25% (capped at 25%)
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW = [
    (Decimal('5000000'), Decimal('0.10')),
    (Decimal('10000000'), Decimal('0.15')),
    (Decimal('20000000'), Decimal('0.25')),
]

# Health and Education Cess rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal('0.04')


# ==========================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ==========================================

def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Sec 288A / 288B: Round to nearest multiple of 10."""
    return amount.quantize(Decimal('10'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


def compute_tax_for_income(taxable_income: Decimal, slabs: list, basic_exemption: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Calculates basic income tax before rebate, surcharge, and cess given income and tax slabs."""
    if taxable_income <= basic_exemption:
        return Decimal('0')
    
    tax = Decimal('0')
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income <= lower:
            continue
        effective_upper = upper if upper is not None else taxable_income
        taxable_in_slab = min(taxable_income, effective_upper) - lower
        if taxable_in_slab > 0:
            tax += taxable_in_slab * rate
    return tax


def get_surcharge_rate(taxable_income: Decimal, is_new_regime: bool) -> Decimal:
    thresholds = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW if is_new_regime else SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_OLD
    applicable_rate = Decimal('0')
    for threshold, rate in thresholds:
        if taxable_income > threshold:
            applicable_rate = rate
    return applicable_rate


def calculate_surcharge_and_marginal_relief(
    taxable_income: Decimal, base_tax: Decimal, is_new_regime: bool
) -> tuple[Decimal, Decimal]:
    """Computes surcharge and applies marginal relief."""
    thresholds = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW if is_new_regime else SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_OLD
    
    # Determine applicable surcharge rate
    surcharge_rate = get_surcharge_rate(taxable_income, is_new_regime)
    if surcharge_rate == 0:
        return Decimal('0'), base_tax

    raw_surcharge = base_tax * surcharge_rate

    # Check marginal relief for each threshold crossed
    applicable_threshold = None
    for threshold, rate in thresholds:
        if taxable_income > threshold:
            applicable_threshold = threshold
            applicable_rate = rate

    if applicable_threshold is not None:
        # Tax + Surcharge at actual income
        actual_total = base_tax + raw_surcharge
        
        # Tax + Surcharge exactly at the threshold
        tax_at_threshold = compute_tax_for_income(
            applicable_threshold,
            SLABS_NEW if is_new_regime else (
                SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60 if True else SLABS_OLD_SENIOR
            ), # Note: slabs at threshold depend on regime, let's be precise below
            SLABS_NEW_BASIC if is_new_regime else SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60_BASIC
        )
        # Re-evaluate proper slabs for threshold if age differs, but threshold tax is standard
        # Actually let's compute threshold tax using correct regime slabs:
        slabs = SLABS_NEW if is_new_regime else None # Will pass correct slabs in main code
        
        # We will handle marginal relief in the main execution blocks where regime & slabs are explicit.
    
    return raw_surcharge, base_tax + raw_surcharge


# ==========================================
# MAIN COMPUTE FUNCTION
# ==========================================

def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp.get('gross_salary', 0)))
    age = int(inp.get('age', 0))
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp.get('hra_received', 0)))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp.get('basic_plus_da', 0)))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp.get('rent_paid', 0)))
    rent_city_is_metro = bool(inp.get('rent_city_is_metro', False))
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp.get('home_loan_interest', 0)))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp.get('sec_80c', 0)))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp.get('sec_80ccd_1b', 0)))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp.get('health_ins_self', 0)))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp.get('health_ins_parents', 0)))
    parents_senior = bool(inp.get('parents_senior', False))

    # ==========================================
    # OLD REGIME COMPUTATION
    # ==========================================
    old_trace = []
    
    # 1. Sec 17(1) Gross Salary
    old_gross_salary = gross_salary
    old_trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(old_gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })

    # 2. Sec 10(13A) HRA Exemption
    hra_exempt = Decimal('0')
    if hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        cond_a = hra_received
        excess_rent = rent_paid - (basic_plus_da * HRA_RENT_EXCESS_PCT)
        cond_b = max(Decimal('0'), excess_rent)
        metro_pct = HRA_METRO_PCT if rent_city_is_metro else HRA_NON_METRO_PCT
        cond_c = basic_plus_da * metro_pct
        hra_exempt = min(cond_a, cond_b, cond_c)
    
    if hra_exempt > 0:
        old_trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "HRA exemption",
            "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
            "clause": "Sec 10(13A) read with Rule 2A"
        })

    # 3. Sec 16(ia) Standard Deduction
    old_std_deduction = min(STD_DEDUCTION_OLD, old_gross_salary)
    old_trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Standard deduction",
        "amount": str(-old_std_deduction),
        "clause": "Sec 16(ia)"
    })

    # Net Salary
    old_net_salary = max(Decimal('0'), old_gross_salary - hra_exempt - old_std_deduction)

    # 4. Sec 24(b) & Sec 71(3A) House Property Loss
    allowed_sop_interest = min(home_loan_interest, SOP_INTEREST_LIMIT)
    hp_loss_setoff = min(allowed_sop_interest, old_net_salary)
    if hp_loss_setoff > 0:
        old_trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
            "amount": str(-hp_loss_setoff),
            "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)"
        })

    # Gross Total Income (Old)
    old_gti = max(Decimal('0'), old_net_salary - hp_loss_setoff)

    # 5. Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old regime)
    # Sec 80C capped at 1,50,000
    ded_80c = min(sec_80c, SEC_80C_LIMIT)
    if ded_80c > 0:
        old_trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Deduction under Section 80C",
            "amount": str(-ded_80c),
            "clause": "Sec 80C"
        })

    # Sec 80CCD(1B) capped at 50,000
    ded_80ccd_1b = min(sec_80ccd_1b, SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT)
    if ded_80ccd_1b > 0:
        old_trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)",
            "amount": str(-ded_80ccd_1b),
            "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
        })

    # Sec 80D Health Insurance
    is_self_senior = age >= 60
    self_limit = SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR if is_self_senior else SEC_80D_SELF_NON_SENIOR
    ded_health_self = min(health_ins_self, self_limit)

    parents_limit = SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENTS_NON_SENIOR
    ded_health_parents = min(health_ins_parents, parents_limit)
    ded_80d = ded_health_self + ded_health_parents

    if ded_80d > 0:
        old_trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Deduction under Section 80D (health insurance)",
            "amount": str(-ded_80d),
            "clause": "Sec 80D"
        })

    total_chapter_via = ded_80c + ded_80ccd_1b + ded_80d
    # Sec 80A(2): Chapter VI-A deductions cannot exceed Gross Total Income
    actual_chapter_via = min(total_chapter_via, old_gti)
    if actual_chapter_via < total_chapter_via and total_chapter_via > 0:
        # If capped, adjust trace amounts proportionally or simply deduct up to GTI
        # For precise trace representation, if capped, we can adjust the last added or record the exact applied amount
        pass # To keep trace clean and truthful, let's ensure sum of income amounts equals total_income.

    # Re-verify total Chapter VI-A applied against GTI
    if total_chapter_via > old_gti:
        # Proportionate or sequential reduction for trace correctness
        excess = total_chapter_via - old_gti
        # Let's rebuild/adjust trace items for deductions if they exceed GTI
        # Simplest: recalculate exact allowed per deduction if capping occurs
        rem_cap = old_gti
        ded_80c_eff = min(ded_80c, rem_cap); rem_cap -= ded_80c_eff
        ded_80ccd_1b_eff = min(ded_80ccd_1b, rem_cap); rem_cap -= ded_80ccd_1b_eff
        ded_80d_eff = min(ded_80d, rem_cap); rem_cap -= ded_80d_eff
        
        # Replace/rewrite trace items for Chapter VI-A
        # Remove previous VI-A trace items if any
        old_trace = [t for t in old_trace if t["clause"] not in ["Sec 80C", "Sec 80CCD(1B)", "Sec 80D"]]
        if ded_80c_eff > 0:
            old_trace.append({"kind": "income", "description": "Deduction under Section 80C", "amount": str(-ded_80c_eff), "clause": "Sec 80C"})
        if ded_80ccd_1b_eff > 0:
            old_trace.append({"kind": "income", "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)", "amount": str(-ded_80ccd_1b_eff), "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"})
        if ded_80d_eff > 0:
            old_trace.append({"kind": "income", "description": "Deduction under Section 80D (health insurance)", "amount": str(-ded_80d_eff), "clause": "Sec 80D"})
        actual_chapter_via = ded_80c_eff + ded_80ccd_1b_eff + ded_80d_eff

    old_total_income_raw = max(Decimal('0'), old_gti - actual_chapter_via)
    old_total_income = round_nearest_ten(old_total_income_raw)

    old_trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Total income (rounded off)",
        "amount": str(old_total_income),
        "clause": "Sec 288A"
    })

    # Tax computation (Old regime)
    if age >= 80:
        old_slabs = SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR
        old_basic_ex = SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR_BASIC
    elif age >= 60:
        old_slabs = SLABS_OLD_SENIOR
        old_basic_ex = SLABS_OLD_SENIOR_BASIC
    else:
        old_slabs = SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60
        old_basic_ex = SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60_BASIC

    old_base_tax = compute_tax_for_income(old_total_income, old_slabs, old_basic_ex)
    if old_base_tax > 0:
        old_trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Income tax on total income",
            "amount": str(old_base_tax),
            "clause": "First Schedule, Part III, Para A"
        })

    # Sec 87A Rebate (Old regime)
    old_rebate = Decimal('0')
    if old_total_income <= REBATE_OLD_LIMIT:
        old_rebate = min(old_base_tax, REBATE_OLD_MAX)
        if old_rebate > 0:
            old_trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Rebate under Section 87A",
                "amount": str(-old_rebate),
                "clause": "Sec 87A"
            })

    old_tax_after_rebate = max(Decimal('0'), old_base_tax - old_rebate)

    # Surcharge & Marginal Relief (Old regime)
    old_surcharge_rate = get_surcharge_rate(old_total_income, is_new_regime=False)
    old_surcharge = Decimal('0')
    if old_surcharge_rate > 0:
        old_surcharge = old_tax_after_rebate * old_surcharge_rate
        
        # Check marginal relief for old regime thresholds (50L, 1Cr, 2Cr, 5Cr)
        applicable_thresh = None
        for thresh, rate in SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_OLD:
            if old_total_income > thresh:
                applicable_thresh = thresh
        
        if applicable_thresh is not None:
            tax_at_thresh = compute_tax_for_income(applicable_thresh, old_slabs, old_basic_ex)
            # Surcharge at threshold
            surch_at_thresh_rate = get_surcharge_rate(applicable_thresh, is_new_regime=False)
            surch_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh * surch_at_thresh_rate
            total_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh + surch_at_thresh
            
            actual_total_with_surch = old_tax_after_rebate + old_surcharge
            max_allowed_total = total_at_thresh + (old_total_income - applicable_thresh)
            if actual_total_with_surch > max_allowed_total:
                old_surcharge = max(Decimal('0'), max_allowed_total - old_tax_after_rebate)

        if old_surcharge > 0:
            old_trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Surcharge (with marginal relief if applicable)",
                "amount": str(old_surcharge),
                "clause": "First Schedule - Surcharge"
            })

    old_tax_plus_surcharge = old_tax_after_rebate + old_surcharge

    # Health and Education Cess (Old regime)
    old_cess = old_tax_plus_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    if old_cess > 0:
        old_trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess @ 4%",
            "amount": str(old_cess),
            "clause": "Health and Education Cess"
        })

    old_tax_payable_raw = old_tax_plus_surcharge + old_cess
    old_tax_payable = round_nearest_ten(old_tax_payable_raw)
    old_trace.append({
        "kind": "tax",
        "description": "Tax payable (rounded off)",
        "amount": str(old_tax_payable),
        "clause": "Sec 288B"
    })


    # ==========================================
    # NEW REGIME COMPUTATION (Sec 115BAC)
    # ==========================================
    new_trace = []

    # 1. Sec 17(1) Gross Salary
    new_gross_salary = gross_salary
    new_trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(new_gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })

    # HRA, Chapter VI-A, SOP interest are NOT allowed under new regime.
    # Standard deduction IS allowed under new regime (75,000)
    new_std_deduction = min(STD_DEDUCTION_NEW, new_gross_salary)
    new_trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Standard deduction",
        "amount": str(-new_std_deduction),
        "clause": "Sec 16(ia) / Sec 115BAC"
    })

    new_total_income_raw = max(Decimal('0'), new_gross_salary - new_std_deduction)
    new_total_income = round_nearest_ten(new_total_income_raw)

    new_trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Total income (rounded off)",
        "amount": str(new_total_income),
        "clause": "Sec 288A"
    })

    # Tax computation (New regime)
    new_base_tax = compute_tax_for_income(new_total_income, SLABS_NEW, SLABS_NEW_BASIC)
    if new_base_tax > 0:
        new_trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Income tax on total income",
            "amount": str(new_base_tax),
            "clause": "Sec 115BAC(1A)"
        })

    # Sec 87A Rebate & Marginal Relief (New regime)
    new_rebate = Decimal('0')
    if new_total_income <= REBATE_NEW_LIMIT:
        new_rebate = min(new_base_tax, REBATE_NEW_MAX)
        if new_rebate > 0:
            new_trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Rebate under Section 87A",
                "amount": str(-new_rebate),
                "clause": "Sec 87A"
            })
    else:
        # Marginal relief for Sec 87A under new regime:
        # If total income exceeds 7,00,000 and income-tax payable exceeds (total income - 7,00,000)
        if new_total_income > REBATE_NEW_LIMIT and new_base_tax > (new_total_income - REBATE_NEW_LIMIT):
            new_rebate = new_base_tax - (new_total_income - REBATE_NEW_LIMIT)
            if new_rebate > 0:
                new_trace.append({
                    "kind": "tax",
                    "description": "Rebate under Section 87A (Marginal relief)",
                    "amount": str(-new_rebate),
                    "clause": "Sec 87A"
                })

    new_tax_after_rebate = max(Decimal('0'), new_base_tax - new_rebate)

    # Surcharge & Marginal Relief (New regime)
    new_surcharge_rate = get_surcharge_rate(new_total_income, is_new_regime=True)
    new_surcharge = Decimal('0')
    if new_surcharge_rate > 0:
        new_surcharge = new_tax_after_rebate * new_surcharge_rate

        # Check marginal relief for new regime thresholds (50L, 1Cr, 2Cr)
        applicable_thresh = None
        for thresh, rate in SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW:
            if new_total_income > thresh:
                applicable_thresh = thresh

        if applicable_thresh is not None:
            tax_at_thresh = compute_tax_for_income(applicable_thresh, SLABS_NEW, SLABS_NEW_BASIC)
            surch_at_thresh_rate = get_surcharge_rate(applicable_thresh, is_new_regime=True)
            surch_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh * surch_at_thresh_rate
            total_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh + surch_at_thresh

            actual_total_with_surch = new_tax_after_rebate + new_surcharge
            max_allowed_total = total_at_thresh + (new_total_income - applicable_thresh)
            if actual_total_with_surch > max_allowed_total:
                new_surcharge = max(Decimal('0'), max_allowed_total - new_tax_after_rebate)

        if new_surcharge > 0:
            new_trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Surcharge (with marginal relief if applicable)",
                "amount": str(new_surcharge),
                "clause": "Sec 115BAC / First Schedule - Surcharge"
            })

    new_tax_plus_surcharge = new_tax_after_rebate + new_surcharge

    # Health and Education Cess (New regime)
    new_cess = new_tax_plus_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    if new_cess > 0:
        new_trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess @ 4%",
            "amount": str(new_cess),
            "clause": "Health and Education Cess"
        })

    new_tax_payable_raw = new_tax_plus_surcharge + new_cess
    new_tax_payable = round_nearest_ten(new_tax_payable_raw)
    new_trace.append({
        "kind": "tax",
        "description": "Tax payable (rounded off)",
        "amount": str(new_tax_payable),
        "clause": "Sec 288B"
    })

    return {
        "old": {
            "total_income": int(old_total_income),
            "tax_payable": int(old_tax_payable),
            "trace": old_trace
        },
        "new": {
            "total_income": int(new_total_income),
            "tax_payable": int(new_tax_payable),
            "trace": new_trace
        }
    }
